scientific_card_excerpt.text: Claim: For a finite-dimensional system xdot=-Kx-diag(alpha)x^{circ3}+e_1 u, y=x_1, x(0)=0, with real symmetric positive-definite K and unknown positive alpha_i, let W be the smallest linear subspace containing e_1, K-invariant, and closed under T(v,w,z)=alpha componentwise-multiplied by v,w,z. Under the source’s exact zero-initial ordered-pulse endpoint-germ interface, known physical dimension N is globally identifiable up to hidden signed permutations fixing e_1 if and only if W=R^N. If W is proper, changing K by a positive perturbation on W-perp can preserve all input-output responses. Without a supplied N, the complete exact input-output germ determines a unique minimum-dimensional realization within the same positive heterogeneous cubic class, of dimension dim W. The source also parameterizes all larger equivalent realizations by weighted signed coordinate blocks, inactive coordinates, and arbitrary positive-definite dynamics on the orthogonal complement. These are source-reported internal theorem candidates.

source_excerpts.text:
THEOREM
Let W be the smallest linear subspace of R^n containing e1 such that
KW is contained in W and T(u,v,w)=alpha*u*v*w belongs to W whenever
u,v,w belong to W. Componentwise products are intended.

(i) If W=R^n, the zero-initial IO germ determines K and alpha, globally
among all n-dimensional models of this form, modulo hidden signed
permutations fixing e1. A finite IO word jet suffices.
(ii) If W is proper, complete IO data do not determine K, even if all
alpha_i are supplied exactly. Thus W=R^n is also necessary for full
recovery in this unrestricted SPD model class.

LEMMA 1 — A PAIRED DIRECTION HAS AN OBSERVABLE SUPPORT EULER FIELD
Suppose v is nonzero and paired with z_v. Put beta_i=alpha_i v_i^2.
Set q0=v, z0=z_v and recursively
  q_(m+1)=-[v,[v,[q_m,f]]]/6,
  z_(m+1)=-L_v^2 F z_m/6.
Differentiating the cubic proves q_m,i=v_i beta_i^m and z_m=q_m dot x.
Consequently
  p_m=L_v z_m(0)=sum_(v_i != 0) v_i^2 beta_i^m.
This is a positive atomic moment sequence. Repeated beta values simply
aggregate their positive weights; zero v_i contribute nothing. Since
alpha_i>0, its distinct atoms are exactly the distinct positive beta_i.

Let r be their number, <=n. The Hankel matrices
H_l=(p_(i+j))_(0<=i,j<l) have rank min(l,r). With p0,...,p_(2n-1),
detect r and solve the positive-definite H_r system
  sum_(j=0)^(r-1) c_j p_(i+j)=-p_(i+r), 0<=i<r.
Then P(t)=t^r+sum_(j=0)^(r-1)c_j t^j is the monic support polynomial.
P(0)!=0. For j=1,...,r define
  D_j=-[v,[q_(j-1),f]]/6=diag(beta_i^j)x.
If P(t)=sum_(j=0)^r c_j t^j with c_r=1, form
  E=-sum_(j=1)^r (c_j/c0) D_j.
Its i-th diagonal coefficient is 1-P(beta_i)/P(0): this is 1 when
v_i!=0 and 0 when v_i=0. Hence E=P_S x where S=support(v).
All coefficients used in E are rational functions of the moments;
individual atom roots are unnecessary at this stage.

LEMMA 2 — K PRESERVES PAIRED CONSTRUCTIBILITY
For the E=P_S x just obtained, let
  R=-[v,f]=Kv+3alpha*x^2*v.
Direct differentiation yields
  [E,R]=3alpha*x^2*v-P_S Kv.
Thus C=R-[E,R]=Kv+P_S Kv is constant, and
  [C,E]=P_S C=2P_S Kv.
Therefore Kv=C-[C,E]/2 is a constructible constant field.

Its paired scalar is
  z_(Kv)=-(I+L_E/6-L_E^2/6) F z_v.
Indeed -Fz_v=(Kv) dot x+sum_i alpha_i v_i x_i^3.
L_E has eigenvalue 0 on linear terms outside S, 1 on linear terms
inside S, and 3 on the displayed cubic. The polynomial

Exact IO germ means the family of positive-duration ordered pulse endpoint
germs Y_a(t)=h(phi_(f+a_m g)^(t_m) o ... o phi_(f+a1 g)^(t_1)(0)),
for a_j in {0,1}, at t=0. Its exact mixed derivatives determine the binary
F/G word coefficients by Boolean polarization. Finite certification below
assumes exact real coefficient values and the exact promised polynomial
model class. Hankel flatness and Gram rank are not statistical hypothesis
tests. Physical node count is not generally recovered; the conclusion is
cross-dimensional uniqueness of the minimal cubic realization.

1. CLASSIFICATION OF REAL COMPONENTWISE TERNARY SUBSPACES

Let U be a finite-dimensional real linear subspace of R^N closed under
componentwise triple products: u*v*w belongs to U for u,v,w in U.
Call coordinate i active if its evaluation functional ell_i on U is nonzero.
On active coordinates, group i~j exactly when ell_i=+/-ell_j. Within a
block B, choose signs s_i so ell_i=s_i ell_(representative).

Choose a generic a in U such that a_i is nonzero on every active
coordinate and a_i^2 differs across different blocks. This is possible
because each forbidden equality is one of finitely many proper linear
hyperplanes ell_i=0 or ell_i+/-ell_j=0. Within B, a_i=s_i a_B.

Ternary closure implies a^(componentwise (2m+1)) belongs to U for
all m>=0. If there are b blocks, the b distinct positive numbers a_B^2
give an invertible Vandermonde matrix. Linear combinations of the first
b odd powers therefore isolate, for each B, its signed indicator
  b_B,i=s_i if i belongs to B, and 0 otherwise.
Each b_B belongs to U. Conversely, by the definition of the coordinate
functional equivalence, every u in U is constant with signs on each B
and is zero on inactive coordinates. Hence
  U=span{b_B : B a block}.
The block supports are disjoint and the number of blocks equals dim U.
This proves the classification, including potentially inactive coordinates.

2. WEIGHTED CUBIC REDUCTION

For the model f=-Kx-alpha*x^3 with alpha_i>0, let W be the smallest
K-invariant alpha-weighted-ternary-closed subspace containing e1.
Set D=diag(sqrt(alpha_i)) and U=D W. Since

source_excerpts.text:
Earlier derivations show that this germ determines a unique minimal
symmetric positive-cubic model (Kbar,alphabar) of dimension r, modulo
hidden signed permutations fixing its port. This is cross-dimensional
minimal-model uniqueness, not recovery of physical N in the general class.

1. COMPLETE PARAMETERIZATION OF ALL EQUIVALENT PHYSICAL MODELS

Fix the canonical minimal r-node model with full closure and choose one
representative (Kbar,alphabar). Every finite physical realization with the
same IO germ is obtained, up to physical relabelings, as follows.

(a) Partition an active subset of {1,...,N} into r nonempty blocks
    B_1,...,B_r, with B_1={1}. Other coordinates are inactive.
(b) Choose alpha_i>0, with
      sum_(i in B_b)1/alpha_i=1/alphabar_b,
    and choose signs s_i in {+1,-1}, with s_1=+1.
    The alpha_i of inactive coordinates are arbitrary positive numbers.
(c) Put Z_b=1/alphabar_b and form the orthonormal block matrix
      V_ib=s_i/(sqrt(alpha_i)*sqrt(Z_b)) for i in B_b, 0 otherwise.
(d) Choose any positive-definite self-adjoint operator H on
    W_perp=(range V)_perp, and put
      K=V Kbar V^T + P_Wperp H P_Wperp.
    The second term means an arbitrary SPD operator on W_perp extended
    by zero on W. When N=r, this term is absent.

There are no further restrictions in the unrestricted real SPD class.
In particular H can couple inactive coordinates to antisynchronous
directions and can mix residual directions belonging to different blocks;
it need not be block diagonal in physical coordinates. It must have no
cross term with range V, exactly because K is symmetric and W-invariant.

Sufficiency: K is SPD, preserves range V, and on that subspace
alpha*x^3=V[alphabar*xi^3] for x=Vxi. V^T e1=e1 and h(Vxi)=xi1.
Thus every zero-initial input trajectory is x=Vxi for the canonical model,
with exactly its IO response. The physical closure equals range V: a
proper smaller closure would project to a proper closure of the canonical
full-closure model.

Necessity: for any physical realization, its closure W is classified by
disjoint weighted signed blocks, as proved in canonical_reduction.txt.
The canonical restriction is signed-permutation equivalent to the fixed
(Kbar,alphabar); reorder and orient the blocks to match it. Their weights
must satisfy the displayed harmonic constraints. Symmetry and invariance
split K orthogonally into the fixed V Kbar V
